known_constants.name: bounce_base_multiplier
known_constants.notes: Official preview states each bounce deals Weapon DMG equal to 40% of Attack.

notes: This is intentionally table-driven because Once Human changes combat wording and stacking behavior by patch.
Do not collapse everything into one universal formula until edge cases are verified in game.
Use when a patch or item explicitly shifts damage from Weapon DMG to Status DMG.
Keep this separate from direct weapon-hit formulas.
